parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { quickMode: '1', triggerSource: 'webhook-quick', startedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Scan completed', data: $json }, null, 2) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: $json.message, data: $json }, null, 2) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'voc-scan', source: 'DefectDojo', sourceRef: 'finding-' + $json.id, title: '[VOC] ' + $json.severity + ': ' + $json.title, description: 'Auto-created by VOC n8n workflow.
Severity: ' + $json.severity + '
Priority: ' + ($json.priority || 'N/A') + '
CVE: ' + ($json.cve || 'N/A') + '
DefectDojo Finding ID: ' + $json.id, severity: $json.severity === 'Critical' ? 4 : $json.severity === 'High' ? 3 : $json.severity === 'Medium' ? 2 : 1, tags: ($json.tags || []).concat(['voc', 'auto-created']), tlp: 2, pap: 2 }) }}
